title: Alistigo CALM node-type extension
description: Extension to FINOS CALM v1.2 that documents the alistigo-specific node-type values used in alistigo architecture models. CALM's node-type field accepts any string; these types give precise semantics within the alistigo context.

module.title: module
module.description: A cohesive unit of functionality with a clearly defined boundary and at least one public interface. Implemented by one or more npm packages. A module enforces encapsulation: consumers interact only through its declared interfaces. Examples: domain, document, ui, artifact, storage, logger.

skill.title: skill
skill.description: An AI agent capability definition node. A skill has no runtime code dependencies — it is a documentation and metadata asset (SKILL.md + optional JSON schema) that describes how an AI agent should generate, configure, and interact with an artifact. Published as an npm package and loaded on demand by AI chat interfaces and agent runtimes.
